name: song_edit
title: Song screen: ADD SLOT twice, the pattern + (encoder), DEL SLOT, play the song from the cursor's slot (state order), undo to the empty journal, redo, undo again; nothing saved

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover Navigator is closed: F7 is CLOSE, F8 would GO since OS-NAV2)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)
(the on-screen keyboard is cancelled with F7, never accepted)
(the cpu counters are since boot or since this reset: a scenario that checks underruns / over-budget starts from zero)
(page 0 first: Song again cycles ORDER / ARRANGEMENT / TIMELINE)
Shift + F1: the cursor to the first slot
(redo on an empty journal: the last message becomes NOTHING TO REDO)

steps.say: PLAY PAT (F1) plays the pattern: no song position
ADD SLOT (F3) twice: the cursor goes to the new slot, Play starts the song there

steps.note: (soft: the order position is the cursor's slot)

steps.say: PAT + (the encoder, one click; F6 is TOOLS since OS-SONGMAP) on the new slot, then DEL SLOT (F4): the cursor falls back one slot
UNDO to the empty journal (8 units: 4 unmutes from the loader + add, add, pattern, delete), REDO to the empty stack, UNDO again

steps.note: the song is as loaded; nothing was saved

steps.say: Play from the first slot of the restored song

finally.note: (a leftover Navigator is closed: F7 is CLOSE, F8 would GO since OS-NAV2)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)
(the on-screen keyboard is cancelled with F7, never accepted)
